scripts.build:all: bash -c 'BASE_PATH=/menu/ pnpm --filter @workspace/menu build & P1=$!; pnpm --filter @workspace/portal build & P2=$!; wait $P1; C1=$?; wait $P2; C2=$?; exit $((C1+C2))' && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/url-utils run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/menu run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test
scripts.check:static: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:hooks && pnpm run check:render-safety
scripts.verify-deployment: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run audit-migrations && pnpm run check:hooks && pnpm run check:render-safety && pnpm run check:freshness && pnpm run check:css-bundle && pnpm run check:no-http-links && pnpm run check:qr-generation
